Description.Name: Visor Strike Vehicle
Description.Details: The B configuration of the Visor Strike Vehicle is a reconnaissance vehicle with an extremely powerful close range punch. Most of its firepower comes from five turret-mounted Clan SRM-4 launchers, backed by a Clan Improved Heavy Medium Laser in the front and a Mine Dispenser. Its electronics are built around a Clan Active Probe and a Clan Angel ECM, and a Remote Sensor Dispenser lets it place sensors in the field. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 8/12 hexes / 240/360 meters. Armor: Ferro-Fibrous (C) Structure: Structure Values A S Front 155 20 Left 110 20 Right 110 20 Rear 110 20 Turret 110 20 Total 595 100 Quirk: Easy to Maintain

YangsThoughts: You'd never pick it out of traffic, Boss, because it looks just like a Puller, the civilian trailer truck nearly every industrial world builds. The Society wanted its undercover intervention teams to have heavy weapons close at hand, so the turret's tucked into the worker compartment behind the cab and the rest of the guns stay covered until the crew needs them. Underneath, though, it's no truck. They gave it a bigger XL fusion engine and thicker Clan-grade ferro-fibrous armor, so small arms won't bother it much, and with thirteen tons of pod space it can handle most support jobs.
